# VoluChat

VoluChat is an autonomous social commerce AI sales agent for Instagram and WhatsApp, connected to Shopify. It automates the complete 90-second social commerce loop: comment-to-DM capture, catalog and sizing intelligence, WhatsApp sales closing, and native in-DM UPI checkout.

## What it does

- Auto-replies to Instagram comments in 2 seconds with exact pricing and slides into DMs
- Checks live Shopify variant inventory, fabric details, and sizing qualification without hallucinations
- Seamlessly transitions warm buyers to WhatsApp, handles objections, and enforces strict margin ceilings
- Generates 1-click UPI payment links and draft orders directly in chat, eliminating website drop-offs
- 100% white-glove setup for an initial 10-store founder cohort with a 10x ROI standard

## Target audience

D2C brands selling on Shopify in India and globally, using Instagram Reels and WhatsApp for social commerce. Particularly brands losing 50%+ of inbound DM inquiries to slow or offline manual chat reps.

## Tech stack

Astro 6 SSR on Vercel, Tailwind CSS v4, GSAP animations. Meta Cloud API and WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration. Shopify GraphQL webhook sync.
